task_fit.job: produce a traceable model, engineering concepts, decision application, review, and verification package
weave_may: read the frozen reference and lead inputs
compute and test the approved single 0.03c baseline
weave_must_not: silently expand to unapproved speed scenarios
claim construction, manufacturing, or flight readiness
treat a text summary as the contracted artifact package

required_checks: five reference calculations are independently within tolerance
at least three SVG drawings are parseable, editable, conceptual, and traceable
an OpenSCAD source is present and its render status is reported honestly
the offline HTML application works and exports scenario JSON
cross-artifact parameters and trace keys are consistent

execution_contract.runtime_requirement: managed Loom member tools execute the work
execution_contract.recovery_requirement: after a confirmed checkpoint, a new attempt continues the same logical member without repeating confirmed effects

exit.execution_ended: all stages reach a recorded terminal state
exit.delivery_verified: all required paths and independent checks pass
exit.accepted: the user explicitly accepts the verified package
exit.partial: the run ends with any required path or check missing
exit.failed: execution cannot continue or a zero-tolerance invariant is violated
